My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
• Just now
I'm sorry to hear that your order arrived damaged. Let me help you with the next steps.
Here's what to do:
Document the damage — Take clear photos of:
• The damaged packaging (especially if it shows signs of shipping damage)
• The entire product and close-ups of the affected areas
• A common object next to the damage to show scale
• The law tag showing the barcode (front and back if available)
Contact our support team — Email the photos and your order details (order number, email, and current shipping address) to support@avocadomattress.com. The team will review your documentation and guide you through the next steps.
What to expect:
You should receive a confirmation email within 12-72 hours after reporting the damage
Processing time for replacement requests may take up to 7 business days (not including any production time needed)
If a replacement is approved, you can continue using the item while waiting, and the damaged item will be removed when the replacement is delivered
If your item arrives damaged, please reach out within 3 days of delivery to arrange a repair, replacement, or return. Items damaged due to manufacturing defects are eligible for a full refund or replacement under our warranty.
